name: Post-Incident Review & Improvement
description: Conducts structured post-incident reviews to identify root causes, extract lessons learned, and implement improvements to prevent recurrence. Tracks improvement actions from identification through implementation and verification.
threat_addressed: Without structured post-incident review, the same compliance failures recur. Root causes go unaddressed, policy gaps persist, and the organization fails to demonstrate the continuous improvement that regulators expect.
enforcement_mechanism: Structured post-incident review process: root cause analysis, regulatory reporting assessment, policy/threshold updates, and lessons learned. Completed within defined timeframe after incident closure. Findings tracked to resolution.

security_outcome.pass: Review process exists and is completed for all qualifying incidents. Findings documented. Action items tracked to closure.
security_outcome.fail: Post-incident review not conducted or improvement actions not tracked.

display_detail: Conducts post-incident reviews and tracks improvement actions to prevent recurrence.
remediation_hint_template: Post-incident review pending. Conduct root cause analysis and document improvement actions for recent incident.
